raw_model_deviations.claim_in_article: A person can take over when AI alone has trouble.
raw_model_deviations.issue: This frames the human-staffed calls as a fallback in which a person takes over when the AI has difficulty. The Ledger confirms that trained contract workers handled some Muse calls, but does not establish this handoff workflow or trigger.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The sentence adds an unverified handoff condition and links human involvement to AI difficulty; it is not merely a paraphrase of the fact that workers handled some calls. The same handoff framing is present in the Japanese source.
raw_model_deviations.qualifier_text: A person can take over when AI alone has trouble. As a system, that may even seem useful.
